card.name: Lists in all-caps warning headings
card.fires_on: Commas or word pieces inside all-caps boxed warning lists, just before the final 'and' of a series of risks. Fires near the end of a list of conditions.

modes.label: Comma before last item
modes.description: The comma after the second-to-last item in an all-caps list of risks.
modes.example: WARNING: ESAs INCREASE THE RISK OF DEATH, MYOCARDIAL INFARCTION<<,>> STROKE, VENOUS THROM

modes.label: Inside a listed term
modes.description: Part of a capitalized medical term in a list, where 'and' or a comma could follow.
modes.example: WARNING: CARDIOVASCULAR DISORDERS, PROBABLE DEMENTIA, BRE<<AST>> CANCER, and ENDOMETRI

card.writes: It pushes the model to continue with 'and' or 'AND' next, in capitals.
card.plain: It signals that a list in a capitalized warning is about to take an 'and' before its last item.
